content: Remain faithful to the earth, and do not believe those who speak to you of other-worldly hopes!
author: Friedrich Nietzsche
story:
There is a sharp, grounded clarity in this observation. True art and creative work are not about clever technique; they demand total emotional skin in the game. When you create safely to please an audience or avoid criticism, the work feels hollow and bloodless.

Across his life and work, Friedrich Nietzsche saw how easily we surrender our tranquility to fear, vanity, and distraction. Pouring your genuine spirit, vulnerability, and raw lived experience into what you make is what gives it enduring life. The work that resonates across centuries is always the work created with unapologetic personal truth.
reflectionPrompt: What long-held assumption about your life or abilities is challenged by this insight?
